column1: # Sandy's curated children's shelf (v0.14.0) — curated going IN,
# not filtered after. Every row was placed here deliberately:
# public-domain tales and the Internet Archive's children's
# collections, through the Archive's own front door. Columns:
# id, title, author, language (iso1), tale group (same tale,
# another tongue), archive id (may be empty), search terms,
# cast (the narrator first), illustrated (1 = the edition is
# known to carry its own pictures).
# This file seeds files/memory/story/curation.tsv on first run;
# the file on the memory hook is the living list.
